name: Rust Mobile
summary:
The globally renowned PC survival game is coming to mobile!

Officially licensed by Rust developer Facepunch Studios, Rust Mobile faithfully recreates the high-risk, high-reward, unpredictable open world of the original, while being optimized for an even better experience on mobile.

Intense PvP warfare, base raiding, crafting and survival... Whether you're at home, commuting, or on a quick break, you can jump straight into the world of Rust.

Rust Mobile retains everything players love about the PC version: open-world exploration, heart-pounding PvP combat, base building, and emergent social gameplay. Now, it's all coming to mobile. The game features a fully explorable sandbox world with dynamic weather, regional biomes, and a real-time day-night cycle. The core loop of Rust remains - loot, craft, raid, die and start over - so every choice you make matters.

Your survival journey on mobile starts now!
